question: In which of the following places is the Vulture Conservation and Breeding Centre located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pinjore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vulture Conservation and Breeding Centre **are located in **Pinjore, Haryana**.

 
 
• It was **established** in the year **2001 as ****Vulture Care Centre**.
 
• It is **administered by the ****Bombay Natural History Society (BNHS)**.
 
• It helps in the** conservation, protection and study **of the reason that causes the death of Vultures. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Vulture**__

 __
 
• **Vultures are Detrivores** which** feed on the dead and decay**.
 
• **Vultures** are** helpful in removing pathogens and toxins** from the environment 
 
• Excessive use of **Diclofenac** as a painkiller in animal husbandry **leads to the cause of death of vultures**.
 
• **Vulture Action Plan 2020-25** was launched by the **Ministry for Environment, Forests and Climate Change for its conservation**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Vulture Conservation and Breeding Centre (VCBC) in India**

 
 
• Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh)
 
• Pinjore, Haryana
 
• Guwahati (Assam)
 
• Hyderabad (Telangana)
